verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but its client tech offering applies AI to client material: Luminance AI document review, a Generative AI legal assistant built with Legora, and the 'Evaluate' tool that automates analysis of bidder responses. These are described only briefly. It is unclear whether clients use them directly or whether lawyers run them as part of a service. The questionnaire generators are rule-based document automation (Contract Express), not AI insights. Missing for 10: evidence of client-facing in-product AI insights or suggestions on the user's own data, any detail on what the AI outputs, hands-on or independent corroboration, and self-serve access.
